messages:
marie: Quick check-in: experiments show layer-18..22 are most sensitive to FP8 noise on codegen prompts. Proposal: per-layer adaptive precision with minimal fence points. Thoughts?

hao: Makes sense. Two constraints: cache format must allow rehydration per-layer, and batching needs mixed-lane handling.

jordan: For detection we can use per-layer max_abs and variance drift; thresholds tuned per-model. If triggered, flip next M layers to INT8/FP16 and set fence.

marie: Implementation plan: prototype as a forward-pass shim that collects stats, decides, and converts on the fly. If this is promising, follow-up RFC for kernel changes.

ops-bot: Captured task: precision-layer-probe assigned marie/hao/jordan, due in sprint.
